assessments.reasoning: I opened the retained Ecma original and checked the staged page extract. The introduction identifies the edition giving the retrospective account. Its chronology expressly assigns adoption of edition one to Ecma’s General Assembly in June 1997.

challenge.method: Check whether June 1997 could refer to the start of drafting, a browser implementation, or international approval.
challenge.results: The chronology dates drafting to November 1996 and ISO/IEC approval to April 1998. The June 1997 entry identifies the adopting body and edition, without dating a precursor implementation.

limitations: The event does not date the earliest precursor language implementation or the distinct ISO/IEC approval.
